---
title: "How Voicenotes connects to Home Assistant"
---

The receiver assembles the watch’s audio chunks, saves the recording, then renames `metadata.json.tmp` to `metadata.json`. Home Assistant’s Folder Watcher uses that move to trigger the notification after the audio is ready. [Set up a notification](../how-to/home-assistant-notifications.qmd)

If Home Assistant cannot receive file events, a custom bridge could send a webhook event with the note ID and recording time after the receiver saves the file. The receiver handles audio storage and acknowledges the watch’s upload requests. [Home Assistant webhook documentation](https://www.home-assistant.io/triggers/webhook/)
